violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: bus pans washed during time of inspection at the three vat sink were not. Being cleaned using sanitizer; only handwashing then rinsing and air drying.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. PIC had employee make a vat of sanitizer and sanitize the bus pans

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. OBSERVED FOOD EMPLOYEE TOUCHING RAW CHICKEN WITH GLOVES ON THEN TAKING OFF GLOVES AND FLIPPING OVER MEAT WITH TONGS ON A GRILL.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. CDI: EMPLOYEE RE-EDUCATED, TONGS WASHED, RINSED, SANITIZED, EMPLOYEE PROPERLY WASHED THEIR HANDS.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED IN HOT HOLDING CABINET: COOKED YUKA AT 130F OBSERVED ON BURNER (OFF): TOMATO SAUCE AT 127F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CDI: BOTH FOODS TAKEN TO STOVE TO REHEAT TO 165F. EMPLOYEES RE-EDUCATED.

violations.title: Cleaning Procedure
violations.observation: Observed food employees using improper handwashing procedures. OBSERVED CFM WASHING HER HANDS WITHOUT SOAP IN THE THREE VAT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wash their hands and exposed portions of their arms by: 1) discarding used gloves; 2) rinsing under warm running water; 3) applying soap; 4) rubbing together for at least 10-15 seconds; 5) rinsing thoroughly under warm running water; and 6) drying with paper towels or air drying device. CDI: CFM WASHED HANDS PROPERLY WITH SOAP IN THE HANDWASHING SINK.

violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee was observed cleaning their hands in a food preparation sink, warewashing sink or in a mop sink. OBSERVED CFM WASHING HER HANDS WITHOUT SOAP IN THE THREE VAT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. CDI: CFM CORRECTED AND WASHED HANDS PROPERLY IN HANDWASHING SINK.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located BY THE THREE-VAT SINK TO BE blocked, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing. OBSERVED THIS HANDWASHING SINK TO BE BLOCKED BY AIR CONDITIONING UNIT.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. CDI: AIR CONDITIONING REMOVED FROM ESTABLISHMENT DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED REFRIED BEANS IN STEAM TABLE AT ~120F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CDI: REFRIED BEANS REHEATED TO ~165F AT TIME OF INSPECTION.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: OBSERVED RAW CHICKEN THAWING IN THE THREE-VAT SINK WITHOUT RUNNING WATER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. CDI: CHICKEN MOVED TO WALK-IN COOLER.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: OBSERVED WET WIPING CLOTHS STORED IN WATER WITHOUT SANITIZER.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. CDI: BLEACH ADDED TO BUCKETS AND READ ~50PPM CHLORINE.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers were observed reused for the storage of SPICES. OBSERVED SPICE CONTAINERS REPURPOSED FOR OTHER SPICES.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. NO CFM WAS PRESENT AT THE TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM ARRIVED BEFORE THE END OF THE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The handwashing sink in the kitchen is equipped with separate cold and hot water faucets rather than a mixing valve or combination faucet. OBSERVED THE HAND SINK HOT WATER AT 83F
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. PIC ADJUSTED THE MIXING VALVE. HOT WATER WAS OBSERVED AT 109F.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw meat stored over pico and shredded lettuce in the walk in cooler
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC REARRANGED THE WALK IN COOLER.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: Observed consumer advisory on the menu screen was missing a disclosure statement.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. PIC ADDED DISCLOSURE STATEMENT TO CONSUMER ADVISORY.
